meta.description: PLFS-specific style rules for narrative generation

trend_increase: The {indicator} increased from {prev_value} in {prev_period} to {curr_value} in {curr_period}.
{indicator} registered an increase of {change} percentage points, rising from {prev_value} to {curr_value}.
An upward movement of {change} percentage points was observed in {indicator} during {curr_period}.
trend_decrease: The {indicator} declined from {prev_value} in {prev_period} to {curr_value} in {curr_period}.
{indicator} recorded a decrease of {change} percentage points over the reference period.
A decline of {change} percentage points was noted in {indicator} during {curr_period}.
trend_stable: The {indicator} remained broadly stable at {curr_value} during {curr_period}.
No significant change was observed in {indicator}, which stood at {curr_value}.
comparison_higher: The {indicator} for {group_a} ({value_a}) was higher than that for {group_b} ({value_b}).
comparison_lower: The {indicator} for {group_a} ({value_a}) was lower than that for {group_b} ({value_b}).
composition: The share of {component} in total {total_label} was {share}%.
level_statement: As per the PLFS {period} estimates, the {indicator} stood at {value}.

rural_urban.template: The {indicator} was {rural_value} in rural areas and {urban_value} in urban areas.
rural_urban.gap_template: The rural-urban gap in {indicator} was {gap} percentage points.

male_female.template: For males, the {indicator} was {male_value}, while for females it was {female_value}.
male_female.gap_template: The gender gap in {indicator} was {gap} percentage points.

quarterly.template: The {indicator} moved from {q1_value} in Q1 to {q4_value} in Q4 of {year}.

annual.template: On an annual basis, the {indicator} changed from {prev_value} ({prev_year}) to {curr_value} ({curr_year}).

formatting_rules.source_citation: Source: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), MoSPI, GoI
